value.rationale: The motivating ecological literature identifies ramping and heterogeneous movement susceptibility, but a global duration decision under jointly competing refuging and exposure mortality was unresolved by the inspected sources. This exact two-class benchmark distinguishes local response peaks from global policy optima, provides a sharp complete transition and a finite optimal-time jump, and identifies the necessary structural heterogeneity. It does not claim direct practical safety calibration.
